description: Agent Enforcement Policies define the local action an agent takes when a discovered AI entity (or a named AI assistant with command-line conditions) matches the policy's criteria. Each policy carries criteria, an action, a message shown to the user, and an apply-to selecting whose agents receive it.

ID.description: ID is the identifier of the object.
ID.title: ID

action.description: The action the agent takes when the criteria match.
action.title: action

criteria.description: The match criteria identifying the AI entities the policy targets, or a named AI assistant with command-line conditions.
criteria.title: criteria

description.description: Description of the agent enforcement policy.
description.title: description

disabled.description: If true, the policy is disabled.
disabled.title: disabled

importHash.description: The hash of the structure used to compare with new import version.
importHash.title: importHash

importLabel.description: The user-defined import label that allows the system to group resources from the same import operation.
importLabel.title: importLabel

message.description: The message shown to the user on the endpoint when the policy matches.
message.title: message

name.description: The internal reference name of the object. It is a sanitized version of Friendly Name if empty.
name.title: name

severity.description: The lowest severity level this policy will apply to.
severity.title: severity

updateTime.description: Last update date of the object.
updateTime.title: updateTime
